{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcsBDxvQzC5t4SaesxgkC","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_0117UPDAw6fYwsxEAi1thW41","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python << 'EOF'\nimport pandas as pd, numpy as np\npd.set_option('display.width', 250)\n\ncomp = pd.read_csv('dataset/companies.csv')\ninv = pd.read_csv('dataset/invoices.csv')\n\ncomp['reg'] = pd.to_datetime(comp.registration_date)\n# company age in months as of ~2020-01 (dataset end)\nref = pd.Timestamp('2020-01-31')\ncomp['age_months'] = (ref - comp.reg).dt.days / 30.44\ncomp['bank_minus_age'] = comp.bank_account_age_months - comp.age_months\n\nprint(\"population: bank_account_age > company age (impossible) count:\",\n      (comp.bank_minus_age > 3).sum())\nprint(comp[comp.bank_minus_age > 3][['company_id','registration_date','employees','declared_revenue_annual','bank_account_age_months']].round(1).to_string())\n\nprint(\"\\ncorrelation bank age vs company age:\", comp[['age_months','bank_account_age_months']].corr().iloc[0,1].round(3))\n\n# do any of the 19 appear in natural rows 240-8999?\nnineteen = [5765,1967,3554,2950, 8810,7021,8770,4521,3495,1060,8285, 4612,8382, 3915,4691,6703,7951, 2029,6453]\nnat = inv.iloc[240:9000]\nprint(\"\\nappearances of the 19 in natural rows: as seller\",\n      nat[nat.seller_id.isin(nineteen)].shape[0], \"as buyer\", nat[nat.buyer_id.isin(nineteen)].shape[0])\n\n# revenue ratio: invoiced sales vs declared revenue for seller-scheme companies\nsales = inv.groupby('seller_id').net_amount.sum()\nfor sid in [4612,8382,3915,4691,6703,7951,2029,6453]:\n    c = comp[comp.company_id==sid].iloc[0]\n    print(f\"{sid}: sales={sales[sid]:,.0f} declared={c.declared_revenue_annual:,.0f} ratio={sales[sid]/c.declared_revenue_annual:.2f} emp={c.employees}\")\nEOF","description":"Check bank-age vs registration coherence and sales-to-declared ratios"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4875,"cache_read_input_tokens":41905,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":4875,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bedbe15c-5092-49d9-bba9-ff70fbed9086","uuid":"4ab2eb4e-2706-472d-83e0-93bcb3e42412","request_id":"req_011CcsBDxJD1a73rsWpAnLZX"}
